notablePrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness. There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.
